caption: The drawing depicts a teapot with ornate details, mainly in shades of gray, blue, and off-white. The teapot is hexagonal with a large, curved handle on the left and a spout angled to the right. The middle section of the teapot displays decorative panels bordered in blue, with relief designs including classical motifs such as a cherub or angel, floral patterns, and swags. The lid has a finial in the shape of a flower, surrounded by a scalloped decorative band also highlighted in blue. To the right of the teapot, there is a small line drawing showing the top view of the lid with the notation "Top. Showing Lid Insertion." To the left, there is a smaller inset illustration labeled "Center Panel of Opposite Side" showing a circular medallion with a profile of a classical figure, flanked by laurel branches. The background is a plain, light beige color and the artist’s signature, "R.B. Wiggin," is in the lower right corner.
title: Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
